supraorbital_contour.structural_silhouette: strongly M-shaped with a distinct central depression
supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Ridge extends laterally beyond the orbital margins by a distance approximately equal to the width of the nasal bridge.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast; the muzzle and chin exhibit light-toned pigmentation compared to the dark, low-intensity pixel values of the periocular and cheek regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: The lower lip exhibits moderate vertical thickness with a visible structural droop and slight eversion at the midline.

other_distinctive_markers: Localized patch of light-colored/white hair present on the chin.
